paper.title_en: Scalar memory from compact binary coalescences
paper.abstract_en: Gravitational memory provides a distinctive low-frequency probe of gravity, but explicit merger studies beyond general relativity remain limited. In this letter, we investigate memory from binary black hole mergers in Ricci-coupled scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity, a natural extension of scalar-Gauss-Bonnet theory that admits an additional scalar breathing polarization. Based on numerical-relativity waveforms of binary black hole coalescences, we show that the change in the scalar charge of the system across merger generates a significant scalar-memory contribution. For a GW150914-like system, this effect modifies the memory signal in a gravitational-wave detector on the same observable timescale and by an amount comparable to the pure scalar-Gauss-Bonnet correction to tensor memory. Thus, it can substantially enhance the total deviation from the general-relativity prediction over a broad range of source and detector configurations. We argue that this identifies a general mechanism: whenever a compact-binary merger changes the asymptotic charge of an additional gravitational field, and that field sources an observable extra polarization, the resulting memory can provide a leading low-frequency signature of new gravitational physics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了广义相对论之外引力波记忆效应，与主题相关。理论深度较高，方法严谨，新颖性中等，整体质量好。
decision.title_zh: 致密双星并合产生的标量记忆
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波记忆提供了引力的一种独特的低频探针，但对广义相对论之外的首次并合研究仍然有限。在这封信中，我们研究了Ricci耦合标量-高斯-邦尼引力中双黑洞并合的记忆效应，这是标量-高斯-邦尼理论的一种自然扩展，允许额外的标量呼吸极化。基于双黑洞并合的数值相对论波形，我们表明系统在并合后标量电荷的变化产生了显著的标量记忆贡献。对于类似GW150914的系统，该效应在可观察的时间尺度上修改了引力波探测器中的记忆信号，并且其大小与纯标量-高斯-邦尼对张量记忆的修正相当。因此，它可以在广泛的源和探测器配置范围内显著增强与广义相对论预测的总偏差。我们认为这确定了一种普遍机制：每当致密双星并合改变了额外引力场的渐近电荷，并且该场产生可观测的额外极化时，由此产生的记忆可以成为新引力物理的主要低频特征。
